text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Dear principal i am writhing this letter","quality":"sentence framing","description":"Uses an explicit opening that establishes the text as a letter and creates a recognizable written context."},{"evidence":"because is something good for the school and for the student","quality":"connected explanation","description":"Gives reasons that link ideas together instead of only listing isolated words or fragments."},{"evidence":"some student would like the idea ... because ... and other would not like the idea","quality":"development of ideas","description":"Expands a position by presenting more than one viewpoint and elaborating the main point."},{"evidence":"changing the school menu ... healthier ... more student would eat the school lunch","quality":"idea organization","description":"Maintains a central topic with related supporting details that stay on the same subject."},{"evidence":"aprove your oppinion ... changing ... student would react","quality":"overall coherence","description":"Forms a continuous message that is readable across several clauses, showing more control of extended writing."}]}
